div.div:
Legend
A: blue dashed — DNS queries and DNS traffic routing, port 53.
B: orange solid — HTTPS requests / routing, port 443, then API invocation.
Numbers are independent per flow; a/b/c selects dev/test/prod (one environment per request).
Filled arrow: caller → callee, or explicitly labeled infrastructure traffic routing.
Normal responses are folded into request labels. Boundaries identify architectural domains.

text.tspan: A: blue dashed — DNS queries and DNS traffic routing, port 53.
B: orange solid — HTTPS requests / routing, port 443, then API invocation.
Numbers are independent per flow; a/b/c selects dev/test/prod (one environment per request).
Filled arrow: caller → callee, or explicitly labeled infrastructure traffic routing.
Normal responses are folded into request labels. Boundaries identify architectural domains.

div.div:
Firewall allowances — apply to Azure Firewall AND AWS Network Firewall
Environment | Source | Destination | Port
dev | dev spoke subnet | Route 53 inbound endpoint IPs | 53
test | test spoke subnet | Route 53 inbound endpoint IPs | 53
prod | prod spoke subnet | Route 53 inbound endpoint IPs | 53
dev / test / prod | corresponding spoke subnet | *.execute-api.{region}.amazonaws.com | 443

div.div:
Architecture parameters and routing roles
{region} and {Route 53 inbound endpoint IPs} are supplied parameters.
Lambda runtime is unspecified; technology: AWS Lambda.
DNS queries pass AWS Network Firewall in this fixture.
Route 53 resolver endpoints do not forward HTTPS.
API access remains subject to each API resource policy.
